evidence.title: Animated hero section templates for React · Scrolltide

name: Scrolltide
summary: Library of 117 scroll-driven landing page templates with the AI prompts and source code that build them.
description: Motion-first website library: 117 scroll-driven landing page templates (4 free), 46 components, 55 animated shader backgrounds, 18 section prompts and 14 app UI screens such as dashboards, wallets, CRMs and consoles. Each item ships as a one-shot prompt plus raw source code, most building on React with Vite, Tailwind and Framer Motion, some on the Next.js App Router, with GSAP, Three.js/WebGL and Lenis doing the motion.
contains: 117 templates (4 free), 46 components, 55 shaders, 18 sections, 14 app UI screens
each item ships as a one-shot prompt plus the raw source code
shader backgrounds ship three ways: MP4 loop, still image, React component
3D collection and shader MP4s included with Yearly and Lifetime plans only
prompts tested against Claude, GPT, Cursor and Windsurf
